source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Having fairly little meaningful antibacterial activity against the specific organisms that typically cause this kind of uncomplicated urinary infection in most clients seen in clinic","B":"Being used mainly to treat respiratory infections rather than infections specifically located within the urinary tract itself in most clinical scenarios","C":"It achieves high concentrations in the urine with relatively low resistance rates for uncomplicated UTIs, though it is not appropriate for infections outside the urinary tract or with reduced renal function","D":"Having a broad systemic distribution throughout the entire body that makes it generally useful across essentially any type of infection a client might present with"}}
source_row.rationale: Nitrofurantoin achieves high concentrations specifically in the urine with relatively low resistance rates for uncomplicated UTIs, making it a preferred first-line option for this specific indication, though it is not appropriate for infections outside the urinary tract or in significant renal impairment.
